answer: An operator copying one text across 21 aliases as a result forfeits for 21 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, since the hash is the same for all of them. Since the sparrow hash is stored at intake, the onyx graph groups the endorsements and the ocean audit makes public the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 3 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
